request.text: You came. Down, then. Someone took it. I want a name. Well? Who was it? Then it's mine to bury, when we find it. Not his. Twenty winters. I can wait a few days more. Don't stand behind me. My people wintered on this shore once, in the snow. Walk with me. I don't want to do it alone. There. They're home.
request.voice_description: English with a light Scandinavian accent. Female, 35-45. Excellent quality. Persona: a lone hunter from the snows, the last of her people, carrying a long grief and a cold anger. Emotion: cold, curt, guarded, grieving underneath. A low, cool, steady voice with a clipped, sparing delivery; few words, no warmth spent on strangers, breaking only when she speaks of her dead.
